title: Print Words Vertically
summary: Given a string s, output all words vertically in their original order, ensuring no trailing spaces.
statement: Given a string s, output all words vertically in their original order, ensuring no trailing spaces. Each word occupies a single column with no extra spaces within the word.
constraints: s contains uppercase words separated by single spaces.
Preserve internal spaces but trim trailing spaces from each vertical row.
reference_solution:
def print_words_vertically(s):
 words=s.split();width=max(map(len,words));return [''.join(word[i] if i<len(word) else ' ' for word in words).rstrip() for i in range(width)]
hints: Split the sentence into words and find the maximum word length.
For each character row, take that position from every word or a space if absent.
This is exactly the column-wise view of left-aligned words.
editorial: This is exactly the column-wise view of left-aligned words.

tests.explanation: Columns form HAY, ORO, and WEU.

arguments: TO BE OR NOT TO BE
